chunks: And in another report, he said: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
Whoever has a child should act childlike for him.

key_terms.اَلنَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.عِنْدَهُ: in his care or with him
key_terms.فَلْيَتَصَابَ: let him behave in a childlike, playful, gentle way

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about how to behave with children?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches gentleness and affectionate engagement with children. It encourages a caregiver to lower themselves to a child's level in manner and interaction, reflecting the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم compassionate conduct.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4707 - In another narration, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
"Whoever has a child should act childishly with him."
